output.entity_proposed: Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in the Municipality of Badian, Province of Cebu
output.proposal: HB No. 9440 seeks to establish a Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) stationed in the Municipality of Badian, Province of Cebu, to serve as the primary office for environmental and natural resources management programs in the 7th District of Cebu. The measure aims to strengthen local capacity to address environmental concerns and to improve coordination among local government units and national government agencies in the district.
output.alignment: As a government organization measure, the review should examine how the proposed CENRO fits with the existing field structure of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and with the environment and natural resources offices of local government units, given that Section 4 (Mandate and General Functions) assigns it functions toward the LGUs while Section 6 (Organizational Structure and Personnel) and Section 7 (Appropriations) place its plantilla and funding under the DENR; the review should also consider whether the creation of a new office is consistent with the streamlining and reduction of overlapping functions authorized under the Government Optimization Act (RA No. 12231). The measure relates to the Environment, climate, and disaster resilience priority area of the FY 2027 Budget Priorities Framework, particularly its focus on coastal and marine conservation, in view of the coastal and marine resources management functions under Section 5 (Specific Powers and Functions). The measure is not among the LEDAC Common Legislative Agenda priorities.
legislative_history: HB No. 9440 was filed in the 20th Congress on May 26, 2026 by Representative Patricia C. Calderon; its status is filed, with later stages not yet recorded.
No earlier version, counterpart measure in the Senate, substitute bill or committee report has been identified.

output.salient_features:
HB No. 9440 seeks to establish a Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in the Municipality of Badian, Province of Cebu, to cater to environmental and natural resources matters in the 7th District of Cebu. Its salient features are as follows:
a. Section 3 (Creation of the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office) provides that the CENRO is created as a regular, permanent office stationed in the Municipality of Badian and serving as the primary office for the formulation, implementation, coordination and monitoring of environmental and natural resources programs, projects and activities in the 7th District of Cebu.
b. Section 4 (Mandate and General Functions) provides that the Office shall formulate and recommend environmental policies, plans and programs to the LGUs concerned, assist in enforcing environmental laws and local ordinances in coordination with the DENR, and coordinate with national agencies, the Provincial Government of Cebu and neighboring LGUs.
c. Section 5 (Specific Powers and Functions) provides that the Office shall prepare and implement an Environmental Management Plan, recommend environmental ordinances to the Sangguniang Bayan, integrate environmental considerations into LGU plans, and assist in enforcing national environmental laws and conducting monitoring and inspections.
d. Section 6 (Organizational Structure and Personnel) provides that the Office shall be headed by an Environment and Natural Resources Officer appointed under civil service rules and shall have five divisions, with the plantilla, qualifications and salary grades to be determined by the DENR Secretary in consultation with the DBM and the CSC; no salary grade is stated in the bill.
e. Section 7 (Appropriations) provides that the DENR Secretary shall include the operationalization of the Office in the Department's program, with funding to be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
f. Section 8 (Implementing Rules and Regulations) provides that the DENR, in coordination with the DILG, the DBM and the CSC, shall issue the implementing rules within ninety days from effectivity.
output.related_measures_policy: No related bill in the current or past Congresses has been identified for HB No. 9440. The measure may be considered alongside the national environmental laws that the Office would help enforce under Section 5 (Specific Powers and Functions), namely RA No. 9003, RA No. 8749, RA No. 9275 and RA No. 9729. It relates to the Environment, climate, and disaster resilience priority area of the FY 2027 Budget Priorities Framework, particularly coastal and marine conservation. The review should assess whether the Office is intended as a DENR field office or a local government office, given the mixed provisions of Section 4 (Mandate and General Functions), Section 6 (Organizational Structure and Personnel) and Section 7 (Appropriations), whether its functions duplicate those of existing DENR offices and LGU environment offices in the 7th District of Cebu, and whether its creation is consistent with the streamlining objectives of the Government Optimization Act (RA No. 12231).

reviewer_checks: Section 3 (Creation of the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office) contains extraneous text within the name of the Office that should be corrected.

Section 6 (Organizational Structure and Personnel) titles the head as "City Environment and Natural Resources Officer" although the Office is a community office in a municipality; confirm the intended title.

Confirm whether the Office is a DENR field office or an LGU office, since Section 4 (Mandate and General Functions) reports to LGUs while Section 6 (Organizational Structure and Personnel) and Section 7 (Appropriations) place staffing and funding under the DENR.
Section 5 (Specific Powers and Functions) refers to the "Municipality or City" and appears incomplete; verify the full text of the section.
No salary grades or funding amount are specified; the cost of the Office and its five divisions should be estimated.
Verify whether an existing DENR community office already covers the 7th District of Cebu.
